newsitem.title: USA: Atrix Intl sees backlog boosting Q4.
newsitem.headline: Atrix Intl sees backlog boosting Q4.

text.p: Atrix International Inc, reporting improved March 31 third-quarter net income, said on Tuesday its backlog is expected to contribute to strong performance for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997.
It said backlog at the end of the third fiscal quarter was up 54 percent over the same year-ago period.
Atrix reported net income rose to $72,257 from $32,962. Sales were $1,560,315 compared to $1,610,685 a year earlier.
The company said results reflect its ongoing transition to a manufacturer of specialty vacuums for toner, asbestos and lead abatement and develops software systems for copy control.
